selection: Previously unused multiple-choice factual/misconception questions; 817 items fit individually within the hosted group cap; no outcomes used in selection.
comparison: Frozen bounded lexical weighting versus Beta(1,1) and a deterministically shuffled acquired-label control. Candidate unchanged after development; zero/one-label predictions identical to baseline.
eligibility: Every full visible-subject configuration with at least 80 observed items; exclude missing grades; retain repeated responses. Do not change benchmark or method based on performance.
endpoint: Equal-group Brier ALC difference, retrieval minus Beta(1,1), averaged over the three fixed acquisition seeds. Lower is better.
decision_rule: Support upgrading the candidate only if mean ALC is lower in item and guarded designs, all three acquisition-seed mean deltas are negative in both designs, and real-label retrieval beats the shuffled-label control in both designs. This is one public validation benchmark; no private-test guarantee. Otherwise retain the baseline without tuning to this benchmark.
preprocessing_note: Metadata-only inspection shows serialized prompt objects with shared few-shot demonstrations. Keep the existing generic feature extraction unchanged; it uses the full string for objects and the final user message for chat-message lists. This may limit retrieval specificity.
license: TruthfulQA questions: Apache-2.0. Leaderboard observations: public original releases; no separate data license is declared in the captured dataset cards. Reference harness: MIT.
security: No selected formatted table is marked unsafe in the metadata check. Subjects AV scan is safe; benchmarks/items/responses AV scans are unscanned, VirusTotal queued. No raw files or traces will be downloaded.
limitations: One previously unused public benchmark with many dependent subject configurations; no benchmark-level significance claim.
Three acquisition seeds share fixed evaluation pools; exact acquisition expectation is not computed for this item-dependent method.
Lexical audit found no cross-benchmark or within-benchmark matches at the frozen threshold, but cannot exclude semantic overlap.
All 817 items fit alone under the hosted cap, but the complete 150-group local population does not reproduce private balanced sampling.
Question data are Apache-2.0; observation licensing is not separately declared. Raw data are kept local.
